name: System requirements

subjectOf.text: Complex smart contract arrangements involving several parties require a verifiable and unhackable system, which blockchain technology supplies.
subjectOf.abstract: More complex smart contract arrangements in which several parties are involved require a verifiable and unhackable system provided by blockchain technology.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Blockchain Applications and Fee Structure Developments in Private Investment Funds (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2959730

subjectOf.text: Locking a user's reputation tokens instead of fungible assets would be a leap in efficiency and a powerful economic advantage over traditional finance, but this advantage is conditional on a coherent system that securely tracks the value of a reputation token.
subjectOf.abstract: For example, locking users reputation tokens instead of your fungible assets would be a strong leap in efficiency, giving a powerful economic advantage over traditional finance. This requires a coherent system which securely tracks the value of a reputation token.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Reputation as Capital – How DAOs Upgrade Finance (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3949098
scope_conditions: a system exists that securely tracks reputation token value
